originality.rationale: The source primitive trinomial example identifies bidegree and leading terms, not the uniform S_q geometric monodromy of the exponent-cover nor the explicit three-branch-value collision-parameter passport and its monodromy. The closed formula for D_q is standard trinomial elimination and is not separately counted as novel. Distinct connected-cover statements and every-coefficient quantification go beyond matching degrees. Classical Belyi priority remains a genuine unresolved risk, but no specific equivalent or stronger theorem was identified in examined material.

value.rationale: Motivated by the first non-binomial primitive support in the new logarithmic A-discriminant theory. It gives a complete global branch-cycle and Galois description of the full family for every smooth coefficient, where published degree/discriminant data alone do not distinguish monodromy or separate spurious infinity factors. It is a structural classification, not an arbitrary numerical slice.
